body:
T=0 h 30 mg 2C-C
Throughout - hexyl nitrite (poppers)
Throughout - Nitrous oxide (10x 8 gram chargers in total each)
Hotel room
My psychedelic exploration partner and I have been systematically working through the available research chemicals in combination with sex. For this one, we chose to experiment with 2C-C, which is an analog of 2C-B known for its erotic nature. We rented a nice hotel room for two days and brought a small sound box and light machine. I am 50 yo male at 65 kg, partner is 45 yo female at 55 kg.
T=0h
Friday at 5 pm we both took a single medium blue crumbly pill available on the clearnet to Dutch customers; these pills had a single vertical score and no other markings. This was advertised as 2C-C. We did not test these for content  beforehand, but their effect largely mirrored what we had seen online.
T=60 minutes.
I feel the first strong effects. First, we both did nitrous balloons together. We immediately noted that 2C-C changes the expected effect of nitrous
We immediately noted that 2C-C changes the expected effect of nitrous
, reducing its dissociative properties and dramatically increasing the euphoria. Second, we decided my partner would perform oral sex on me, while I did a balloon, since I was already feeling it. This became a profoundly intense erotic experience: we were rolling together sexually connected like an alligator rolling its prey underwater, and that our thrashing was creating the universe.
T=1.5-2 hours. Plateau reached.
We decided I would manually stimulate my partner while she did poppers. She describes it as liquid, I was melting, everything was fluid, she and I were melting together. Shortly thereafter she went down on me, I took amyl, and had a very similar reaction. These drugs played very well together. We spent a fairly long time exploring this particular combination of poppers and varieties of sex on 2C-C. We alternated between using poppers and nitrous. My partner felt the poppers were more erotic (which is the usual for me, also), but in this particular case, I found that the nitrous was the more erotic accelerant. Nitrous consistently produced a series of science-fiction porn visions (sorry, but that is my best description).
T=4 hours.
We decided to try to reach orgasm while performing intercourse. We consciously locked eyes the entire time, speaking erotically to each other, and we were very surprised at how easily this happened. After orgasm, we attempted to talk, but I was not making sense at all, and I fell asleep almost immediately.
T=5 hours.
We were both fully asleep for 10 hours, waking with no hangover.
Additional comments
* 2C-C has no anxiolytic properties, and may even increase anxiety. Each time I went to do a balloon or poppers, I verbalised that I was nervous and scared  this is decidedly not normal for me.
* I was much more impacted by this drug than my partner was, much higher.
* 2C-C was for me a very erotic drug, particularly combined with proper accelerants.
* Mostly clear and lucid headspace with waves of altered consciousness.
* No OEV, but some CEV did happen as expected.
This was a calm and short acting drug. Without the nitrous and poppers, we both think it would have been a rather boring experience, compared to most other compounds we have tried.
